title: Parse a markdown table and write CSV
prompt: Write table.js with two exports. parseTable(md) takes a markdown table (header row, separator row like |---|:--:|, then data rows; cells may be padded with spaces; a pipe inside a cell is escaped as \|) and returns an array of objects keyed by the header names. toCsv(rows) turns such an array back into CSV text: a header line from the keys of the first row, then one line per row, lines joined with \n and ending with \n; a value containing a comma, a double quote or a newline is wrapped in double quotes with inner quotes doubled.
